verdict.rationale: Supabase's MCP server lets external AI assistants query and interact with project data on the user's behalf, which could surface insights, and its pgvector/AI toolkit supports building AI features on top of the data — but there is no evidence of Supabase itself generating in-product insights, summaries, or suggestions from a user's data (e.g., an AI-powered dashboard analysis feature). missing for 10: evidence of a first-party in-dashboard AI insights/suggestions feature, hands-on examples of AI-generated analysis, and independent corroboration of quality/usefulness.
